goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.role: a melee attacker that charges the nearest enemy and never backs off
goblin.standingOrder: Charge the nearest enemy and keep hitting it. Never back off.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.role: a disciplined shooter that holds the back line and fires a crossbow
hobgoblin.standingOrder: Hold your ground and shoot anyone who comes in range. Do not charge.
